body.zh-Hant: 阿圖爾·達席爾瓦·貝爾納德斯（Artur da Silva Bernardes）1875年8月8日生於米納斯吉拉斯州維索薩，父親是葡萄牙人。1900年12月他取得法學學士文憑；DHBB 稱他是自該縣設立以來第一位取得法學學位的維索薩子弟。
body.en: Artur da Silva Bernardes was born in Viçosa, Minas Gerais, on 8 August 1875, the son of a Portuguese father. In December 1900 he received his law degree; the DHBB says he was the first son of Viçosa to graduate in law since the district was established.

citations.quote: nasceu em Viçosa (MG) no dia 8 de agosto de 1875
Seu pai era português
Em dezembro de 1900 recebeu o diploma de bacharel em ciências jurídicas
era o primeiro filho de Viçosa a diplomar-se em direito

heading.zh-Hant: 地方政治到米納斯州州長
heading.en: From local politics to the state presidency of Minas

body.zh-Hant: 1904年11月19日州內舉行市議員選舉，共和黨米納斯派（PRM）維索薩支部提名他為特謝拉斯區市議員。1909年5月24日，他的聯邦眾議員選舉結果獲確認並就任；1910年9月他中斷任期，出任米納斯州政府財政廳長。1918年9月，他的米納斯州州長任期開始。
body.en: On 19 November 1904 municipal elections were held across the state, and the Viçosa section of the Partido Republicano Mineiro (PRM) put him forward as a councillor for the district of Teixeiras. On 24 May 1909 his election as federal deputy was recognised and he took his seat; in September 1910 he interrupted that term to become finance secretary of the Minas government. His government of Minas began in September 1918.

body.zh-Hant: 1922年3月的選舉中，各共和黨的黨機器運作順利，從一開始就顯示他將獲勝。1922年11月15日他就任巴西總統，是第一位在戒嚴期間就職的總統。DHBB 認為他任內最重要的舉動，是1926年6月10日讓巴西退出國際聯盟；同年11月15日他把政府交給新任總統。
body.en: In the March 1922 election the Republican party machines worked smoothly and made his victory clear from the start. On 15 November 1922 he took office as president of Brazil, the first president to be inaugurated under a state of siege. The DHBB calls his most important act the withdrawal of Brazil from the League of Nations, on 10 June 1926; on 15 November of that year he handed the government to the new president.

o primeiro presidente a tomar posse (15 de novembro de 1922) na vigência
Mas seu ato mais importante foi a retirada do Brasil da Liga das Nações
Quando o Brasil se retirou da organização, em 10 de junho de 1926
no dia 15 de novembro Bernardes passou o governo ao novo presidente da República

body.zh-Hant: 1932年2月，米納斯協議促成社會民族黨（PSN）成立，他列名該黨領導委員會；該黨於同年5月解散。9月23日他在阿拉龐加被捕，12月底抵達里斯本流亡。
body.en: In February 1932 the Minas Agreement produced the Partido Social Nacionalista (PSN), and he sat on its directing committee; the party was dissolved in May of the same year. On 23 September he was arrested at Araponga, and he reached Lisbon in late December 1932 to go into exile.

heading.en: The UDN, the Republican Party and later years

body.zh-Hant: 1945年4月7日UDN舉行首次全國大會；4月21日第二次會議指派首屆全國領導委員會，臨時領導委員會成員包括貝爾納德斯。8月14日他宣布成立共和黨（PR）並使其派系脫離UDN；10月15日他獲指派主持該黨，並一直擔任到去世。1955年新一屆國會於2月1日開議，他於3月23日在里約逝世。
body.en: The UDN held its first national convention on 7 April 1945; on 21 April a second meeting named its first national directorate, with a provisional directing committee that included Bernardes. On 14 August he announced the creation of the Partido Republicano (PR) and the withdrawal of his faction from the UDN; on 15 October he was named to preside over that party, which he did until his death. The new legislature of 1955 opened on 1 February, and he died in Rio on 23 March.

body.zh-Hant: 愛德華多·桑托斯（Eduardo Santos Montejo）生於1888年，出生地為通哈，1974年卒於波哥大。德國國家圖書館權威檔稱他是哥倫比亞的記者、法學家與政治人物。他取得國立大學法律與政治學博士，並從1909年起擔任《評論》（La Revista）的負責人。
body.en: Eduardo Santos Montejo was born in Tunja in 1888 and died in Bogotá in 1974. The German National Library authority record calls him a Colombian journalist, jurist and politician. He took a doctorate in law and political science at the Universidad Nacional and from 1909 was director of La Revista.

citations.locator: Eduardo Santos 條目, 開頭
citations.quote: (Tunja, 1888-Bogotá, 1974)
Kolumbian. Journalist, Jurist und Politiker (Präsident Kolumbiens 1938-1942)
Doctor en Derecho y Ciencias Políticas de la Universidad Nacional.
Desde el año de 1909 fue director de “La Revista”.

body.zh-Hant: 1909至1911年他是哥倫比亞駐巴黎公使館的名譽隨員，1911年任外交部高級事務官（Oficial Mayor）。1915至1917年任波哥大市參議員，1917至1918年任昆迪納馬卡議會議員，1921至1923年任波哥大市議會議員。
body.en: From 1909 to 1911 he was an honorary attaché at the Colombian legation in Paris, and in 1911 he was Oficial Mayor of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. He was a Bogotá councillor (regidor) in 1915–1917, a deputy in the Cundinamarca assembly in 1917–1918, and a Bogotá municipal councillor in 1921–1923.

citations.quote: Adjunto ad honorem a la Legación de Colombia en París entre 1909 y 1911.
Oficial Mayor del Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores en 1911.
Regidor de Bogotá entre 1915 y 1917.
Diputado a la Asamblea de Cundinamarca entre 1917 y 1918.
Consejero Municipal de Bogotá entre 1921 y 1923.

heading.en: Congress, the League and the presidency

body.zh-Hant: 1933年2月21日他以哥倫比亞代表身分在國際聯盟發表演說。他於1935至1939年任參議員，1939年出任參議院議長。1938年他接替洛佩斯·普馬雷霍就任總統，任期到1942年；任內成立工業發展局、市政發展局與領土信貸局等機構。二戰期間，他是拉丁美洲最親美的領導人之一。
body.en: On 21 February 1933 he addressed the League of Nations as Colombia's delegate. He was a senator from 1935 to 1939 and in 1939 became president of the Senate. In 1938 he succeeded Alfonso López Pumarejo as president, serving until 1942; his administration created institutes including the Industrial Development Institute, the Municipal Development Institute and the Territorial Credit Institute. During the Second World War he was among the most pro-U.S. leaders of Latin America.

citations.quote: Discurso pronunciado el 21 de febrero de 1933 ante la Sociedad de las Naciones
Excmo. Sr. Eduardo Santos, Delegado de Colombia

llegando en este último año a ocupar la presidencia de la corporación.
In 1938 he succeeded Alfonso López Pumarejo in the presidency

para el periodo comprendido entre 1938 y 1942.

and the Territorial Credit Institute, among others, were created

During World War II Santos was among the most pro-U.S. leaders of Latin America

body.zh-Hant: 1942年12月1日他成為哥倫比亞歷史學院的正式院士。1943年12月25日，這位卸任總統把終身退休金捐給學院。學院的歷任院長名單列有他1945至1946年的任期。
body.en: On 1 December 1942 he became a full member of the Academia Colombiana de Historia. On 25 December 1943 the former president gave the Academy his lifetime pension. The Academy's list of past presidents shows his term in 1945–1946.

body.zh-Hant: 愛德華多·謝雷爾（Eduardo Schaerer）1873年12月2日生，1941年11月12日去世。他與戰爭後來到巴拉圭的德國殖民者有親屬關係，出生於內陸小村卡阿薩帕。他的都市氣質與效率，對他在國立中學與日後的商業事務上都有益處。
body.en: Eduardo Schaerer was born on 2 December 1873 and died on 12 November 1941. He was related to German colonists who came to Paraguay after the war, and was born in Caazapá, a small hamlet in the interior. His urban ambitions and efficiency served him well at the Colegio Nacional and later in business.

citations.quote: Eduardo Schaerer (b. 2 December 1873; d. 12 November 1941)
Schaerer was related to German colonists who came to Paraguay in the wake

Though he was born in Caazapá, a small hamlet in the Paraguayan interior

heading.en: The Liberal Party and the presidency

body.zh-Hant: 謝雷爾屬於自由黨。1904年革命後自由黨掌權，他擔任過海關總署署長、亞松森市長與內政部長等要職。他用自己的財富推動競選總統，總統任期為1912至1916年。任內亞松森持續現代化，以啟用電車系統最為突出；第一次世界大戰期間他讓巴拉圭保持中立。
body.en: Schaerer was a Liberal. After the Liberal Party came to power following the 1904 revolution, he held posts including director general of the Customs House, mayor of Asunción and interior minister. He used his money to promote his candidacy for president, and served as president in 1912–1916. During his administration Asunción was modernised, most visibly by the inauguration of a tramway system, and he kept Paraguay neutral during the First World War.

body.zh-Hant: 任期結束後，謝雷爾仍在自由黨圈子中很有影響力。他一度擔任國家參議員，最後成為參議院議長。他也為多份自由黨報紙提供資金，直到1930年代仍是黨內重要力量；1941年11月12日去世。
body.en: After his term ended Schaerer remained influential in Liberal circles. For a time he was a national senator and eventually became president of the Senate. He also financed various Liberal newspapers and remained an important force in the party into the 1930s; he died on 12 November 1941.
